facts.value: June 15 for the winter semester and December 15 for the summer semester
Documents must be sent by mail directly to the student secretariat
For applications intended for scientific reasons as a second study, documents including justification, certificates, etc. must be submitted.
Registration at hochschulstart.de is necessary for applications for DoSV study programs before an online application in Goethe-Campus.
If you have not yet completed your studies, it is considered an application for a first degree if you do not receive your final certificate by the end of the application deadline.
